arm_notes.acp: small re-implementation in the spirit of action-conditioned future prediction; not an official reproduction of Kwon et al. (arXiv:2402.07102)
arm_notes.branch_vs_nobranch: collection-method difference under the same transition cap, not identical data
arm_notes.msp: action-free ablation (zero action input); nominal parameter parity only; not a strong or SOTA baseline

rules: INCOMPLETE if any required cell is not OK
EVALUATOR_UNRESOLVED if informative_control < 0.90 in any seed
LEARNING_BENEFIT_NOT_SUPPORTED if R1 (acp_branch - random) < MIE in any seed
SATURATED_COMPARISON if all four learned arms >= 0.95 in every seed
PRELIMINARY_COLLECTION_BENEFIT if S1 >= MIE in every seed (equal transition cap; reset privilege required; compute differs)
ACTION_CONDITIONING_ONLY if H1 or S2 >= MIE in every seed but S1 is not (not distinguishable from the existing action-conditioning explanation)
NO_CONSISTENT_MIE_CONTRAST otherwise (not evidence of zero effect or equivalence)
Other contrasts and the interaction are reported descriptively without MIE

frozen_before_run: 2026-09-26; seeds, arms, data budgets, pretraining and readout settings, decision rules and caps fixed before any study metric was computed

head.selection_rule: lowest head_dev reward_mse among checkpoints of one 80-epoch run; ties -> fewer epochs; test never used; grid not extended if 80 is selected

name: study_2x2_symmetric_v1

pretraining.note: Fixed from configs/pilot_memory_prereg.json stage1 (default lr); the pre-registered lr grid is NOT used in this limited study (no tuning).

question: Under the same transition budget and readout protocol, how do the effects of branching collection and action conditioning separate?

readout_pool.note: Shared by all six arms; collected once per seed with no branching and no restores (splits head_train/head_dev). No existing pool met the restore-free condition (the diagnostic pool used branching).

resource_caps.estimate_note: ~1,800 CPU-s per seed from a timing-only benchmark (stage-1 2.9 s/epoch branch, 5.7 s/epoch no-branch; readout ~3.0 s/epoch)

seed_registry.note: Seeds 1-3 were used by unit tests only to collect small-maze train-split data (no evaluation). After this run seeds 1-3 are viewed and count as development data. New seeds are not an independent external replication.
seed_registry.rule: first three seeds of the pre-registered evaluation list [0..9] whose evaluation outputs were not viewed before this run

viewed_before.0: smoke runs and unit tests (evaluation viewed)
